items.text: How do you say … in English?
items.reading: ˈhaʊ duː juː ˈseɪ … ɪn ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: How do you say "kreng jai" in English?
dialogue.reading: ˈhaʊ duː juː ˈseɪ ˈkrɛŋ ˈdʒaɪ ɪn ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Sorry, I don't know! What does it mean?
dialogue.reading: ˈsɑːri, aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈnoʊ! ˈwʌt dʌz ɪt ˈmiːn?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Hmm… It's a very Thai word!
dialogue.reading: ˈhm… ɪts ə ˈvɛri ˈtaɪ ˈwɜːrd!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ! ˈkrɛŋ ˈdʒaɪ. aɪ ˈlaɪk ɪt!
